messages.subject: [pomp-announce] pomp version 0.39-2 released
messages.body_plain:
Dear pomp users,

I've just submitted version pomp 0.39-2 to CRAN.  Source code and binaries should become available on the mirrors over the next few days.  This is a feature upgrade and bug fix release.  
Specifically, the 'plot' method for 'pomp' objects has been improved and some relatively obscure bugs have been fixed.  See the package NEWS and ChangeLog files for details.

All the best,

Aaron

-- 
Aaron A. King, Ph.D.
Ecology & Evolutionary Biology
Mathematics
Center for the Study of Complex Systems
University of Michigan

messages.subject: [pomp-announce] pomp version 0.39-3 released
messages.body_plain:
Dear pomp users,

I've just submitted version pomp 0.39-3 to CRAN.  Source code and binaries should become available on the mirrors over the next few days.  This is a feature and documentation upgrade 
and bug fix release.  The new feature is the ability of 'mif' now to estimate initial-value parameters alone.  See the package NEWS and ChangeLog files for details.

All the best,

Aaron
